fhc_record_year = {
	fhc_compute_year = yes
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = fhc_start_year } }
		set_global_variable = { name = fhc_start_year value = global_var:fhc_cur_year }
	}
	set_global_variable = { name = fhc_slot value = global_var:fhc_cur_year }
	change_global_variable = { name = fhc_slot subtract = global_var:fhc_start_year }
	if = {  # full after 150 years: keep the first 150
		limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 0 global_var:fhc_slot < 150 }
		if = {
			limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 75 }
			if = {
				limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 112 }
				if = {
					limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 131 }
					if = {
						limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 140 }
						if = {
							limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 145 }
							if = {
								limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 147 }
								if = {
									limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 148 }
									if = {
										limit = { global_var:fhc_slot >= 149 }
										fhc_record_slot = { S = 149 }
									}
									else = {

									}
								}

								}

							else = {

fhc_record_slot = {
	set_global_variable = { name = fhc_year_$S$ value = global_var:fhc_cur_year }
	set_global_variable = { name = fhc_last_slot value = $S$ }
	every_country = { fhc_record_country = { S = $S$ } }
}

fhc_record_country = {
	set_variable = { name = fhc_gdp_$S$ value = gdp }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_pop_$S$ value = total_population }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_gdppc_$S$ value = { value = gdp divide = { value = total_population min = 1 } } }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_prestige_$S$ value = prestige }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_lit_$S$ value = literacy_rate }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_sol_$S$ value = average_sol }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_income_$S$ value = income }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_gold_$S$ value = gold_reserves }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_debt_$S$ value = principal }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_army_$S$ value = army_size }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_navy_$S$ value = navy_size }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_rad_$S$ value = radical_fraction }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_loy_$S$ value = loyalist_fraction }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_infamy_$S$ value = infamy }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_lslot var:fhc_lslot < $S$ }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_gdp_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_gdp_prev value = var:fhc_gdp_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_pop_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_pop_prev value = var:fhc_pop_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_gdppc_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_gdppc_prev value = var:fhc_gdppc_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_prestige_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_prestige_prev value = var:fhc_prestige_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_lit_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_lit_prev value = var:fhc_lit_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_sol_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_sol_prev value = var:fhc_sol_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_income_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_income_prev value = var:fhc_income_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_gold_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_gold_prev value = var:fhc_gold_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_debt_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_debt_prev value = var:fhc_debt_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_army_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_army_prev value = var:fhc_army_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_navy_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_navy_prev value = var:fhc_navy_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_rad_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_rad_prev value = var:fhc_rad_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_loy_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_loy_prev value = var:fhc_loy_last } }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = fhc_infamy_last } set_variable = { name = fhc_infamy_prev value = var:fhc_infamy_last } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = fhc_lslot value = $S$ }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_gdp_last value = var:fhc_gdp_$S$ }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_gdp_first } } set_variable = { name = fhc_gdp_first value = var:fhc_gdp_$S$ } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_gdp_max } var:fhc_gdp_$S$ > var:fhc_gdp_max } } set_variable = { name = fhc_gdp_max value = var:fhc_gdp_$S$ } }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_pop_last value = var:fhc_pop_$S$ }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_pop_first } } set_variable = { name = fhc_pop_first value = var:fhc_pop_$S$ } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_pop_max } var:fhc_pop_$S$ > var:fhc_pop_max } } set_variable = { name = fhc_pop_max value = var:fhc_pop_$S$ } }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_gdppc_last value = var:fhc_gdppc_$S$ }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_gdppc_first } } set_variable = { name = fhc_gdppc_first value = var:fhc_gdppc_$S$ } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_gdppc_max } var:fhc_gdppc_$S$ > var:fhc_gdppc_max } } set_variable = { name = fhc_gdppc_max value = var:fhc_gdppc_$S$ } }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_prestige_last value = var:fhc_prestige_$S$ }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_prestige_first } } set_variable = { name = fhc_prestige_first value = var:fhc_prestige_$S$ } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_prestige_max } var:fhc_prestige_$S$ > var:fhc_prestige_max } } set_variable = { name = fhc_prestige_max value = var:fhc_prestige_$S$ } }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_lit_last value = var:fhc_lit_$S$ }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_lit_first } } set_variable = { name = fhc_lit_first value = var:fhc_lit_$S$ } }
	if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_lit_max } var:fhc_lit_$S$ > var:fhc_lit_max } } set_variable = { name = fhc_lit_max value = var:fhc_lit_$S$ } }
	set_variable = { name = fhc_sol_last value = var:fhc_sol_$S$ }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = fhc_sol_first } } set_variable = { name = fhc_sol_first value = var:fhc_sol_$S$ } }
